name: zenmoney-receipts
description: Receipt-safe MCP server and OpenAI plugin for ZenMoney receipts, taxonomy, and spending insights.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/index.ts src/cli.ts src/backend.ts src/backend-entry.ts src/hosted-entry.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outdir=dist --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node"
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.doctor:live: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js doctor --live
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run eval:receipts && npm run verify:repo
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test:hosted-http
